offering_description.value: CSG sells billing, revenue management, and customer experience software to telecom, broadband, and media providers and other enterprises. It also processes payments for merchants and government agencies. It delivers its software through cloud and managed deployments and helps customers integrate it with their existing systems.

primary_products.value: Subscriber billing and revenue management software; digital commerce and subscription management software; partner billing and settlement software; customer communications and journey management software; payment gateway software

primary_services.value: Managed billing operations; payment processing; software implementation and integration; outsourced customer statement delivery

customer_segment.value: B2B: Telecom and broadband operators, media providers, other enterprises, merchants, and software vendors; B2G: Government agencies that collect taxes, fees, and other public payments

end_markets.value: Telecommunications and broadband; pay television and digital media; retail and e-commerce; financial services; government services

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to hosted billing, commerce, and customer experience software; transaction or usage fees: Billing volumes, payment transactions, and customer communications processed; licensing or royalties: Licenses for enterprise software deployed in customer environments; service fees: Managed operations, software integration, and customer statement delivery
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Turns subscriber, usage, and account data into bills, settlements, and customer communications for service providers and enterprises; service provider: Runs billing and statement delivery using client account data and integrates software for enterprise customers; financial intermediary: Routes card and bank payment instructions between merchants or public agencies and financial networks
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Subscriber billing, digital commerce, customer communications, and payment processing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving telecom operators, media providers, merchants, and government agencies; partners / resellers: Software vendors and payment partners that embed payment processing in their products

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Subscriber and payment data handling under privacy laws such as GDPR, PCI DSS standards, and Nacha rules
